% Pattern: number/class-section. revtex4 prints \thesection as \Roman{section},
% so a theorem numbered within the section prints II.1. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem I.1
% want lem-1 statement/lemma II.1
% want thm-2 statement/theorem II.2
\documentclass[prd]{revtex4}
\newtheorem{Thm}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{Lem}[Thm]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{Thm} Every compact space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\section{Two}
\begin{Lem} Every finite space is compact. \end{Lem}
\begin{Thm} Every finite space is bounded. \end{Thm}
\end{document}
